anatomical_scale_policy: Fixed one scale per source sheet from its neutral upright frame and visually cross-checked head/torso; no per-frame bounding-box scaling; crouches remain shorter.
interpolation: none, generated keyframes; later repeated recovery frames allow separately tracked victim flight

frames.finger_mask: tight hand-only elliptical alpha intersection, 14x16px per hand

limitations: Keyframe prototype; no interpolation or optical flow.
Grip landmarks are manually measured visual anchors with roughly 3px game-scale uncertainty, not runtime hitboxes.
Static grab_hold intentionally reuses the exact final grab_start pose for seamless hold.
Independent victim and weapon layers included; no enemy baked into Kennyo body.
No game runtime, website or repository changes.
path_base: Paths are relative to grabs directory unless labeled source crop paths; ../weapons refers to package-level shared weapons.
